text:
leo: flagging an incident - after yesterday's RBAC expansion roll, several customers report SCIM 429 spikes and a subset seeing SAML logins fail with signature errors. seeing KMS decrypt errors in provisioner logs. can someone pick this up?
tanya: oncall here. tenant affected: fintech-one-prod and retail-hq. paste logs?
leo: snippet from provisioner: 
```
2026-03-22T11:02:12Z identity-provisioner ERROR kms: decrypt failed: NotFound
2026-03-22T11:02:13Z scim PATCH 429 tenant=fintech-one-prod body_len=3901 id=usr_xxx
2026-03-22T11:02:14Z auth-gateway WARN saml: assertion_len=4680 groups=520
```
jordan: seems like two correlated issues: 1) RBAC expansion increased groups per-assertion, 2) KMS rotation left a re-encrypt backlog so some secrets still encrypted under old key alias. role assumption cache means workers temporarily couldn't decrypt.
leo: immediate mitigations proposed: pause SCIM retry loops for affected tenants, backfill re-encrypt with high priority, and temporarily cap assertion group payloads to prevent header truncation. any objections?
tanya: agree. I'm pausing retries for fintech-one-prod and retail-hq now. pausing also flips off background SCIM flood retries.
devops-bot: action executed: scim.retry.pause tenant=fintech-one-prod; scim.retry.pause tenant=retail-hq
jordan: promoting re-encrypt job and increasing worker QPS; also adding alias-history lookup in decrypt path so NotFound triggers lookup of previous alias mapping before failing. will push a small hotfix.
kms-bot: rotation status: 2026-03-22T09:30 rotated master key k-identity-2026. alias switched. re-encrypt queued items: 12,400; completed: 2,110.
leo: good. also add a temporary auth-gateway cap: if assertion_len > 4k, truncate groups and add attribute group_overflow=true, return 429 to IdP with clear diagnostic so upstream can split assertions.
tanya: pushed gateway config change to canary. monitoring SAML success rate.
jordan: hotfix PR: `identity-provisioner: alias-history fallback + retry` opened and running codebuild. will request expedited review.
leo: customer comms: telling impacted customers we've paused retries and are resolving decrypt backlog; expect improvement in 15-30m.
tanya: metrics: SCIM 429s for fintech-one-prod dropped from 180/min -> 12/min after pause. SAML signature failures also decreased.
leo: after re-encrypt finishes, we'll re-enable retries gradually and revert gateway truncation if not needed. postmortem items: safer KMS rotation playbook (check worker IAM propagation), assertion size guardrail, sequenced RBAC rollout to avoid mass group inflation, and alias-history support in decrypt flow.
jordan: i'll own the alias-history impl and PR. tanya will own playbook updates. leo will own postmortem and customer follow-ups.
leo: thanks team. leaving monitoring for 45m and will update incident channel.
